# Preserve-parent fork — D-038
Parent revision 7 contains `g-director-42` (`origin: director_grant`) and `g-vp-room-read` (`origin: vp_configured`). After the director grant is revoked, a child fork with `fork_mode: preserve_parent_snapshot` copies both grants and revision 7. The revoked-derived right remains available to ordinary session calls. No automatic resync occurs. A later authorized resync advances to revision 8, removes the revoked-derived right atomically, and writes an audit row. The readback includes parent session/bond, fork point, mode, policy revision, lineage and resync scope.
